title: Fishy Hub | AutoFarm, Trolls, AutoSell, MoneyFarm, TP n More
features:
Smuggling Auto Farm – Automates buying, carrying, and selling selected illegal items (Avacados, Wagyu, etc.) with configurable seller, item, movement speed, and carry capacity (5 or 8).
Money/Profit Tracker – Live tracking of money gained, elapsed time, and $/hour while auto farming.
Truck & Boat Mission Autofarm – Automates starting, waiting, and delivering for truck and boat missions, with contraband percentage and speed controls.
Jobs & Environment Automation – Auto box job, taco cleaning, and cash orb collection with speed sliders.
Money Printer Features – Collects cash from nearby printers and optionally auto-buys printers for passive farming.
High-Value Goods Farms – Dedicated autofarms for Rings, Mona Lisa, and El Diablo Box.
Teleports – Quick teleport to predefined locations and to specific players, with global speed control.
Aimbot – Target selection with FOV, smoothing, hitbox choice, visibility check, FOV circle, and target switching.
ESP – Name/HP ESP and box ESP with tactical filters (civilians only, boat smugglers, apartment suspects).
Auto Robbery – Fully automated bank and jewellery store robberies, plus one-click bank rob.
Vehicle Tools – Spawn nearest vehicle/boat, delete all vehicles, and teleport to own vehicle.
Player Enhancements – WalkSpeed, JumpPower, Noclip, Infinite Jump, Fly with speed control, character reset, and server rejoin.
Troll Features – Target selection, fling, orbit, attach, teleport behind, spectate, and copy position.
Menu & Settings – Customizable keybinds, custom cursor, always-on-top, theme support, and save/load configuration.
